leadText: Pokémon Adventures: The Impassable Mr. Mime is the twelfth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters twenty-seven, twenty-eight, and twenty-nine of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later compiled into the final chapter of and the first two chapters of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
